### Key to the genera of subfamily *Polynoinae*
1(8) 15 pairs of elytra, with lateral and one median antenna
2(5) Body short, entirely covered by elytra
3(4) Lateral antennae attached almost terminally . . . . 1. Genus *Harmothoe* Kinberg
4(3) Lateral antennae attached ventrally . . . . 4. Genus *Antinoe* Kinberg
5(2) Body not completely covered by elytra; posterior end without elytra
6(7) Body short, narrowing posteriorly. 40—50 body segments . . . . . . . . 2. Genus *Lagisca* Malmgren
7(6) Body long, worm-like, 50—100 segments . . 3. Genus *Polynoe* Savigny
8(1) Elytra numerous, extending to posterior end of body . . . . . 5. Genus *Lepidasthenia* Malmgren

### 1. Genus *Harmothoe* Kinberg, 1855
Body relatively short, with no more than 40—50 segments.
why: 真实写法：Marinov 1977 b07.md 第 8–16 行（正反条成对编号，括号为对立条号，无去向接下一号）。结构照原书，3/4 去向据原书补全为合成值。旧 key-model 对原文识别 0 张表，keygraph 报 53 个 single_branch 误报。
